frame.derivation: Two equal columns: uy=-P*L/(2*E*A), P=1000 N, L=3 m, E=200e9 Pa, A=0.01 m2; symmetric vertical loading produces pure axial response.

truss.derivation: Unit-load virtual work: uy=-P/(E*A)*(sqrt(2)+1/2), two 45-degree diagonals and two bottom-chord halves; the central vertical member carries zero axial load.

solid.derivation: Uniaxial compression, nu=0: uy=-p/E*(y+0.5), p=1e6 Pa, E=200e9 Pa. Constant strain is exactly represented by P1 tetrahedra.

thermal.quantity: temperature field with volumetric generation and inward surface flux
thermal.derivation: -k*T''=g, T(0)=300, k*T'(1)=q. T(x)=300+(q+g)*x/k-g*x*x/(2*k) with x=X+0.5, k=10 W/(m K), q=100 W/m2, g=100 W/m3; exact quadratic represented by P2. Source=4 W, inward surface heat=4 W, cold-boundary outward heat=8 W.

fluid.quantity: developed planar Poiseuille velocity and pressure gradient
fluid.derivation: 0=-dp/dx+mu*d2u/dy2, no slip: u=6*Umean*eta*(1-eta); pressure gradient=-12*mu*Umean/H^2. Uniform-inlet low-Re case is sampled only in developed central section, excluding entrance/outlet effects; Umean=0.001 m/s, H=1 m, nu=0.01 m2/s, rho=998.2 kg/m3.

invariance.notes: SI/mm are display-unit variants of the same canonical SI input; fingerprint must remain identical. MPI comparison uses scalar field extrema and raw conservation aggregates.
